facts.assertion: Planning Data documents a coordinate query using latitude and longitude to return entities whose geometry intersects the point.
A coordinate query may specify multiple datasets in the same request, including green-belt, conservation-area and article-4-direction-area.
Planning Data says returned entity fields can include name, dataset, start-date, geometry and point.
Planning Data explicitly warns that absence of query results does not prove absence of constraints because coverage varies by area.
The entity search endpoint exposes a period parameter for current or all entries and latitude/longitude spatial filters.
For hundreds of properties or more, Planning Data recommends bulk downloads and local spatial intersections to avoid rate limits and provide a stable snapshot.
